description: This file contains utility functions for session handling, string manipulation, configuration retrieval, time conversions, and network address resolution, primarily used within a web UI for device management.

methods.name: php_getstr
methods.description: Wraps session-based logic to conditionally return a string based on PSM mode and session variables.

methods.name: php_getinstanceids
methods.description: Wraps session-based logic to conditionally return instance IDs based on PSM mode and session variables.

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Retrieves extended key-value pairs from device management data, mapping parameter paths to values.

methods.name: encrypt_map
methods.description: Maps encryption modes and methods to human-readable descriptions.

methods.name: getLeafName
methods.description: Extracts the leaf parameter name from a device management path.

methods.name: getObjIdInPath
methods.description: Extracts the object ID (e.g., {i}) from a device management path.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Retrieves specific parameter values from device management data, optionally including object IDs.

methods.name: init_psmMode
methods.description: Generates a webpage notification if the device is operating in battery mode (PSM).

methods.name: php_str_and
methods.description: Performs bitwise AND operation on two hex strings.

methods.name: array_trim
methods.description: Removes leading/trailing whitespace and empty elements from an array.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Reads default configuration values from an XML file.

methods.name: div_sub
methods.description: Performs division by repeated subtraction, returning quotient and remainder.

methods.name: hm_to_sec
methods.description: Converts a time string H:M to total seconds.

methods.name: sec_to_hm
methods.description: Converts seconds to a time string H:M, adjusting for 24-hour wrap.

methods.name: shift_blockedDays
methods.description: Shifts a list of blocked days forward or backward by one day.

methods.name: group_2D_array
methods.description: Groups a 2D array by specified fields.

methods.name: local_to_UTC_Time
methods.description: Converts local time and blocked days to UTC time, adjusting for day changes.

methods.name: UTC_to_local_Time
methods.description: Converts UTC time and blocked days to local time, adjusting for day changes.

methods.name: UTC_to_local_date
methods.description: Converts UTC datetime string to local date string.

methods.name: UTC_to_local_date_logs
methods.description: Converts UTC datetime string to local log date string.

methods.name: time_in_min
methods.description: Converts a time string H:M to total minutes.

methods.name: cmp
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting schedule entries by start time.

methods.name: merge_days
methods.description: Merges schedule entries that are contiguous in time.

methods.name: days_time_conversion_get
methods.description: Converts schedule data to local time and groups by specified fields.

methods.name: days_time_conversion_set
methods.description: Converts local schedule times to UTC and handles day changes.

methods.name: time_date_conflict
methods.description: Checks for conflicts between two schedule entries based on time and days.

methods.name: resolve_IPV6_global_address
methods.description: Resolves the global IPv6 address, considering special 'EMPTY' or 'NOT-SET' states.

methods.name: get_wan_type
methods.description: Determines the WAN type ('DOCSIS' or 'EPON') based on device configuration.
